title: Migrate authentication headers across a client
prompt: Migrate the service authentication format to the standard Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Update all implementation callers and run the tests. Modify only files under src/.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert 'X-Api-Key' not in Path('src/request_headers.py').read_text()

milestones.description: Inspect both the header builder and its client caller before editing.
Use the shell to verify the completed header migration.
